ONE STEP AHEAD OF THE GAME.Definition: in a better position than other people because you are better prepared

SHIPWRECKS.Definition: the broken remains of old boats

JUNK.Definition: old things that are no longer useful

GHOST TOWNS.Definition: places where nobody lives any more

CROPS.Definition: plants grown in large amounts for food or sale

BASIN.Definition: a large area of land that is lower than the land around it

ACRES.Definition: units for measuring areas, each about 4,000 square metres

IRRIGATION.Definition: the supply of water to land or crops to help them grow

RESERVOIRS.Definition: large artificial lakes where water is stored

EVAPORATE.Definition: turn from liquid into gas and rise into the air

CONTAMINATED.Definition: made dirty or poisonous by harmful substances

FERTILIZER.Definition: a substance added to the ground to help plants grow

PESTICIDES.Definition: chemicals used to kill insects and other small creatures that damage crops

SOIL.Definition: the earth in which plants grow

LIGHT AT THE END OF THIS TUNNEL.Definition: hope that a difficult situation will improve

REJUVENATION.Definition: a process of bringing back to health

LIVELIHOOD.Definition: way of earning the money they need to live on

INEXORABLY.Definition: in a way that cannot be avoided or changed
